aboutText: Based in Altona North, AI Electrical & Data has been delivering reliable electrical solutions across Melbourne's west for years. Our licensed and insured electricians handle everything from residential rewiring to complex commercial installations. We pride ourselves on prompt, professional service and with 24/7 availability, you can count on us when you need an electrician most. From switchboard upgrades to data cabling, we've got Altona North covered.
servicesText: From Altona North homes to Melbourne's wider commercial spaces, AI Electrical & Data delivers a complete range of electrical and data services. Our licensed and insured electricians are available around the clock, providing quality workmanship with transparent pricing on every job.
